mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2% increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) over the past 6 months indicates rising inflation expectations, which can lead to higher interest rates and decreased consumer spending, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or CPI increases are not followed by significant interest rate hikes (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A 0.5% decrease in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) over the past 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to higher wages and increased consumer spending, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening labor market periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2% increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) over the past 6 months indicates rising economic activity, which can lead to higher demand for goods and services, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or INDPRO increases are not followed by significant economic growth (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A 0.5% increase in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past 3 months signals a tightening monetary cycle, which can lead to higher interest rates and decreased consumer spending, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening monetary cycle periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 1% decrease in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) over the past 6 months indicates falling inflation expectations, which can lead to lower interest rates and increased consumer spending, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or CPI decreases are not followed by significant interest rate cuts (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A 0.5% increase in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) over the past 3 months signals a loosening labor market, which can lead to lower wages and decreased consumer spending, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in loosening labor market periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 0.5% increase in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) and a 1% increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) over the past 3 months signal a tightening monetary cycle and rising economic activity, which can lead to higher interest rates and increased demand for goods and services, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases > 0.5% in 3 months and INDPRO increases > 1% in 3 months
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in tightening monetary cycle periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
